items.title: RTX, Pentagon Sign $23 Billion Tomahawk Missile Contract
items.summary: The Department of Defense has been pushing contractors to ramp up production of critical munitions. RTX stock rose about 1% on Monday.

items.title: 1 Industrials Stock for Long-Term Investors and 2 We Ignore
items.summary: Whether you see them or not, industrials businesses play a crucial part in our daily activities. Still, their generally high capital requirements expose them to the ups and downs of economic cycles, and the industry’s six-month return of 2.7% has fallen short of the S&P 500’s 13.9% rise.

items.title: Sandisk, Micron, Coherent, Boeing, Apple, Amazon, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Coherent is the best-performing stock in the S&P 500 on Monday. Sandisk, Micron, Marvell, and other AI stocks also rise.

items.title: United Launch Alliance names new CEO amid Vulcan rocket travails
items.summary: Longtime United Launch Alliance President and CEO Tory Bruno jumped ship right before Christmas last year, moving on to work with Blue Origin. After eight months of interim leadership, ULA has named Mark Peller as his replacement. items.title: Boeing Falls After Army Grounds Apaches, but Commerial Jets Matter the Most
items.summary: The Army has temporarily grounded its Apache helicopters after a crash near Fort Hood, Texas, which killed two service members.  Boeing  makes Apaches, and its stock fell on Monday as investors watched for developments.  The crash remains a watch item, but investors will probably shift their focus back to commercial airplane production.

items.title: 3 Reasons We Love FTAI Aviation (FTAI)
items.summary: What a brutal six months it’s been for FTAI Aviation. The stock has dropped 24.5% and now trades at $215.84, rattling many shareholders. This was partly due to its softer quarterly results and may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.

items.title: Korean Air installing automated cargo equipment at Incheon, JFK terminals
items.summary: Korean Air is making large capital expenditures in container handling automation and refrigerated store rooms at two key cargo hubs. The post Korean Air installing automated cargo equipment at Incheon, JFK terminals appeared first on FreightWaves.

items.title: Tomahawk Missile Production Is Surging—and These Stocks Could Benefit
items.summary: RTX won a $22.9 billion Navy contract aimed at dramatically increasing Tomahawk missile production. L3Harris, General Dynamics, and other defense companies could benefit from the ramp-up.
